blind.description: A stylized fantasy-style stone pedestal or display plinth. It features a tiered square base, an octagonal central column with carved vertical leaf/shield relief motifs on its faces, and an expanded square capital with a recessed flat platform on top. All surfaces are solid, smooth, and cleanly modeled with hand-painted stylized grey stone textures.
blind.from_above: A square top with slightly beveled edges surrounding a recessed, square-shaped flat central display area with rounded corners.
blind.height_vs_figure: About 2.5 to 3 feet tall (reaching roughly hip-height on the 5 ft 9 in figure) and about 1.5 feet wide at the top and base.
